description: The new window width can exceed the token dimensions used to plan model placement.
trigger: Run the standalone evaluator with a valid corpus window longer than 2048 tokens and a model that loads through the split loader.
expected_behavior: Size the load estimate for the requested forward width, or reject widths outside the supported configuration.
actual_behavior: Model placement is planned with the same 2048-token dummy chunk and output estimate, then `main` forwards the whole longer row and requests logits at every position. Conversely, a shorter window does not reduce the load-time estimate.

verification.description: Traced the fixed load arguments and the variable-width forward separately. Changing the estimate would require adjusting both chunk and output size: the dummy logit width is bounded by both.
verification.limits: The mismatch does not prove any particular GPU will run out of memory or that a given model accepts the longer context.

introductions.rationale: The width becomes caller-selectable while the placement estimate continues to use fixed chunk and output sizes of 2048.
